entries.title: OpenStreetMap · Wicker Park extract
entries.creator: OpenStreetMap contributors
entries.modifications: XML converted to JSON retaining drivable roads, buildings, mapped parks/green spaces and shop/amenity points. Traffic signal/stop/yield tags retained on road nodes; runtime control mapping preserves approach direction and labels modeled defaults. Standalone control nodes are retained by the preparation script where present. Runtime graph simplification and original procedural city rendering.

previousSha256.notes: Original filtered extract, before retaining mapped green spaces.

entries.title: Leaflet 1.9.4
entries.creator: Vladimir (Volodymyr) Agafonkin and Leaflet contributors; CloudMade
entries.modifications: Unmodified distributed JavaScript and CSS. The district picker uses an original CSS DivIcon; stock marker/layer-control image assets are not used. Basemap tiles are requested live from OpenStreetMap with visible attribution; no tiles are bundled.

entries.title: OpenStreetMap Standard live district basemap
entries.creator: OpenStreetMap contributors; OpenStreetMap Carto by Andy Allan and contributors, based on original cartography by Steve Chilton and others
entries.copyright: OpenStreetMap contributors (data); OpenStreetMap Carto authors dedicated cartographic design to the public domain
entries.license: ODbL 1.0 (data); CC0 1.0 (OpenStreetMap Carto design); tile service usage policy applies
entries.modifications: Live viewport tiles are displayed unchanged by Leaflet with visible contributor attribution. No map tiles are bundled or prefetched. An original movable pin and control-boundary rectangle are overlaid. Exact deployed tile style revision and individual runtime tile hashes are unknown and vary with location and time.
